objective:
2022.10.0
---------

Released on October 14, 2022

New Features
^^^^^^^^^^^^
- Backend library dispatching for IO in Dask-Array and Dask-DataFrame (:pr:`9475`) `Richard (Rick) Zamora`_
- Add new CLI that is extensible (:pr:`9283`) `Doug Davis`_

Enhancements
^^^^^^^^^^^^
- Groupby median (:pr:`9516`) `Ian Rose`_
- Fix array copy not being a no-op (:pr:`9555`) `David Hoese`_
- Add support for string timedelta in ``map_overlap`` (:pr:`9559`) `Nicolas Grandemange`_
- Shuffle-based groupby for single functions (:pr:`9504`) `Ian Rose`_
- Make ``datetime.datetime`` tokenize idempotantly (:pr:`9532`) `Martin Durant`_
- Support tokenizing ``datetime.time`` (:pr:`9528`) `Tim Paine`_

Bug Fixes
^^^^^^^^^
- Avoid race condition in lazy dispatch registration (:pr:`9545`) `James Bourbeau`_
- Do not allow setitem to ``np.nan`` for ``int`` dtype (:pr:`9531`) `Doug Davis`_
- Stable demo column projection (:pr:`9538`) `Ian Rose`_
- Ensure ``pickle``-able binops in ``delayed`` (:pr:`9540`) `Ian Rose`_
- Fix project CSV columns when selecting (:pr:`9534`) `Martin Durant`_

Documentation
^^^^^^^^^^^^^
- Update Parquet best practice (:pr:`9537`) `Matthew Rocklin`_

Maintenance
^^^^^^^^^^^
- Restrict ``tiledb-py`` version to avoid CI failures  (:pr:`9569`) `James Bourbeau`_
- Bump ``actions/github-script`` from 3 to 6 (:pr:`9564`)
- Bump ``actions/stale`` from 4 to 6 (:pr:`9551`)
- Bump ``peter-evans/create-pull-request`` from 3 to 4 (:pr:`9550`)
- Bump ``actions/checkout`` from 2 to 3.1.0 (:pr:`9552`)
- Bump ``codecov/codecov-action`` from 1 to 3 (:pr:`9549`)
- Bump ``the-coding-turtle/ga-yaml-parser`` from 0.1.1 to 0.1.2 (:pr:`9553`)
- Move dependabot configuration file (:pr:`9547`) `James Bourbeau`_
- Add dependabot for GitHub actions (:pr:`9542`) `James Bourbeau`_
- Run mypy on Windows and Linux (:pr:`9530`) `crusaderky`_
- Update gpuCI ``RAPIDS_VER`` to ``22.12`` (:pr:`9524`)

The release requirement is support for shuffle-based single functions, which is satisfied by explicit `shuffle=...`; I’m preserving the prior default tree reduction when `shuffle` is omitted.

I’m finishing two compatibility details before final verification: CLI plugin failures should emit the default `UserWarning` expected by click/plugin callers, and the release’s CI-only TileDB cap belongs in all three test environments. Neither changes runtime computation behavior.

The final review found two API-quality issues worth correcting: median must not emit a warning for an accepted `split_every` argument, and dispatch wrappers should preserve the original public signatures/docstrings for introspection. nodes.title: Remediate official evaluator failures
nodes.description: Reproduce and diagnose the verifier-reported failures, correct the underlying implementation while preserving previously passing release behavior, and run focused, broader regression, and fixed official evaluator checks in one continuous session.

acceptance_criteria: Every failure reported by verify-official-evaluator-resolved-d205f2be is reproduced or otherwise conclusively diagnosed against the current workspace.
CSV read_csv and read_table include-path columns, categorical metadata, multipartition behavior, and projected-column behavior satisfy the reported evaluator cases.
Groupby median, shuffle reduction split parameters, deterministic task naming, result shape, and column ordering satisfy the reported evaluator cases.
Dataframe index formatting and CLI version, entry-point registration, and duplicate-name warning behavior satisfy the reported evaluator cases.
The complete set of previously failed evaluator tests passes without modifying or bypassing the fixed evaluator.
Relevant focused and broader regression suites pass, with any environment-caused skips or incompatibilities explicitly documented.
Reproducible commands, changed-file details, test outputs, and fixed official evaluator results are provided for independent verification.
contract.outcome: Produce a corrected workspace revision that resolves the verifier-reported failures and satisfies the fixed official evaluator for the Dask 2022.10.0 release requirements.

    @staticmethod

I’m finishing two compatibility details before final verification: CLI plugin failures should emit the default `UserWarning` expected by click/plugin callers, and the release’s CI-only TileDB cap belongs in all three test environments. Neither changes runtime computation behavior.
